Name: Unique Jealousy Responses
Author: minervamaga
TagLine: Changes the spouse jealousy dialogue to be unique to each spouse
Description:
DO NOT DOWNLOAD THIS MOD FROM ANYWHERE EXCEPT HERE, MODDROP, OR MY GITHUB
Other websites are stealing mods from Nexus and uploading them without permission, while earning money on each mod they steal.  My mods are always found on the three sites listed above and no where else.

Inspired by MissCoriel's mod, I decided to add custom jealousy messages to my [Poly Friendly Events](https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2101) mod.  And after some thought, I decided to make the custom responses their own mod, for those who don't want to use my Poly mod.  Instead of always losing friendship points with your spouse, now you can choose to be honest and gain friendship or lie and lose points.  This dialogue mod would not be possible without my writer [Shwetan's](https://www.nexusmods.com/users/38486275) contribution, so please go check out their page!

This mod requires [Content Patcher](https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915) to work!

Mod creators, this mod can be used to add unique messages to your NPCs as well.  Please see the articles tab for an example.  SVE is not and will never be supported.

WORKS WITH SDV 1.4!

**Install**

1.  [Install the latest version of SMAPI](https://smapi.io/).

2.  [Install Content Patcher](https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915).

3.  Download this mod and unzip it, then copy  the '[CP] Unique Jealousy Responses' folder into Mods.

4.  You're done, run the game!
